prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup game asset sprite atlas. Produce ONE square high-resolution 5-column x 5-row sprite atlas of exactly TWENTY FIVE individually isolated hotpot ingredient icons, with TRUE transparent alpha background. This is a production game texture to be cut on exact uniform 5x5 boundaries; every cell must contain ONLY the named food, centrally placed within 70 percent of the cell; each cell keeps at least 15 percent empty transparent padding on all sides. NO plates, NO bowls, NO tile backing, NO text, NO labels, NO cell borders, NO scenery. Style reference images show the approved appetizing food quality: premium polished semi-realistic 3D food illustrations, fresh recognizable colors, slightly rounded friendly forms, subtle tactile surfaces, coherent 3/4 top-down view and gentle top-left light. Foods must fit equally well on red wood, cream clay, celadon porcelain and rice-paper theme tiles, so keep natural food colors and no theme-colored background tint. Strict row-major ordered identities:
ROW 1 left to right: beef = 3 red marbled beef rolls; shrimp = 1 curled cooked orange shrimp; vegetable = small bok choy leaves; mushroom = 1 shiitake mushroom cap with scored white star; corn = golden corn cob segment.
ROW 2: fish = 3 pink white fish slices; egg = cut quail egg half with yellow yolk plus small speckled shell; jzg = tan tea-tree mushroom cluster (brown slender stalks, small brown caps); meetball = 3 brown meatballs; ou = pale lotus root slices with circular holes.
ROW 3: tomato = red tomato slices; toufu = smooth ivory tofu cubes; ydf = porous frozen tofu cubes (visibly sponge-like yellow-beige); tripe = black-gray honeycomb beef tripe folds; duckblood = deep burgundy duck blood cubes.
ROW 4: potato = thin golden potato slices; crabstick = red-and-white surimi crab sticks; noodle = translucent wide flat starch noodles folded into ribbons; luncheon = pink rectangular luncheon meat slices; kelp = dark green knotted kelp.
ROW 5: lamb = pale pink lamb rolls with creamy white fat clearly distinct from red beef rolls; blackchicken = chopped black-skinned chicken pieces, dark gray skin with pale cut flesh; yam = ivory Chinese yam cylinders with dark speckled skin on one side; okra = bright green okra pods plus one star-shaped cross-section; tendon = pale golden translucent beef tendon pieces.
Exactly 5 rows and 5 columns, precisely equal cell sizes and even spacing. Food identities MUST NOT migrate between cells. Complete isolated forms and no clipping or overflow. Crisp detailed game-ready rendering, about 2000x2000 pixels or largest supported square. No watermark.
